summary: Travian entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Travian

emulation.notes: Use the current native or official release route where available.

primary.why: Travian is a strategy game played directly in the browser; mobile apps are companion/current service routes, but the desktop browser remains the cleanest complete capture and multitasking route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Travian: Legends server in a desktop browser. Record server speed/world, start date, tribe, and capture date because rounds and seasonal specials rotate.

all_releases.fidelity: Native browser route for the persistent round-based strategy service.
all_releases.reason: primary: best complete route and strongest capture/management setup.

all_releases.platform: iOS / Android mobile app or mobile browser
all_releases.fidelity: Official mobile access for Travian: Legends.
all_releases.reason: skip: useful for checking villages and alerts, but desktop browser is more complete for archive capture and coordination.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No platform-exclusive campaign/mode route is sourced; the issue is live server/round selection.

entries.remaster_caveats: Round-based worlds, speeds, tribes, events, and balance vary; record the world and date for any archive note.
